subject: Procurement kickstart — vendor onboarding & PO steps
messages:
From: Jordan Baxter <jordan.baxter@palmerhealth.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: procure+onboarding@palmerhealth.com
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro & procurement intake — Palmer x Redwood

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Palmer Health is ready to move forward with Redwood for inference serving on our clinical-search pilot. Procurement wants to run a short intake to capture PO requirements, SOW acceptance window, and any vendor onboarding forms you need. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm the PO flow (who signs, expected lead times for vendor invoices)
- Any standard onboarding forms (W-9, vendor questionnaire, SOC 2 evidence request)
- A short mutual action plan (MAP) so both teams know owners & dates

Would you be available for a 30-minute kickstart call next week? Our procurement window is tight — ideally to get a PO committed by Nov 5.

Attaching our internal procurement intake template for context: Palmer_PO_Template_v1.docx (see stub).

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Baxter
Senior Procurement Manager, Palmer Health
jordan.baxter@palmerhealth.com
Attachment: Palmer_PO_Template_v1.docx (attachment stub)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Baxter <jordan.baxter@palmerhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro & procurement intake — Palmer x Redwood

Jordan — thank you, this is great context. Happy to run the kickstart. Proposed 30-minute slots (PT):

- Tues, Oct 20 — 9:30–10:00am PT
- Wed, Oct 21 — 11:00–11:30am PT
- Thu, Oct 22 — 2:00–2:30pm PT

Goal for the call: align on vendor setup checklist, PO path & contacts, and a lightweight MAP we can iterate on. I’ll bring procurement-facing artifacts: Redwood vendor onboarding form, sample PO invoice flow, and the MAP template.

Pre-call asks (short):
- Jordan: can you confirm the signatory and billing entity for the PO?
- If you have Palmer’s vendor questionnaire, drop it to me ahead of the call (procure+onboarding email is fine).

I’m looping in Karthik (legal/procurement enablement) and Neha (finance ops) to own next steps on our side.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Attachment: none

Looping in a few specifics from Redwood’s side to make the call productive:

Proposed 30-minute agenda (we can tighten):
1) 5m — Introductions & outcome agreement (PO date, signatory)
2) 10m — Vendor setup requirements (forms we need: W-9, vendor questionnaire, bank details)
3) 7m — PO & invoicing path (who at Palmer signs & expected SLA for invoice processing)
4) 5m — MAP / next steps owners & target dates

Internal owners (Redwood):
- Procurement intake & vendor form: Neha Kapoor (neha_kapoor@redwood.com)
- Legal / contract redlines: Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer@redwood.com)
- Billing & invoicing: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com)

Quick checklist I’ll prepare and bring to the call (attachment stub):
- Redwood vendor onboarding form (redwood_procurement_form_v2.pdf)
- MAP draft for Palmer with recommended milestones & owners (MAP-draft-palmer.xlsx)
- SOC 2 summary & evidence guide (link to shared folder)

If Jordan can confirm signatory and billing entity today, we’ll pre-populate the MAP so the call can be used to finalize dates.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_procurement_form_v2.pdf (attachment stub); MAP-draft-palmer.xlsx (attachment stub)

Subject: Confirmed: Procurement kickstart call — Tue Oct 20 9:30am PT

Jordan / team — confirmed for Tue, Oct 20 at 9:30am PT (30 minutes). Calendar invite sent separately.

What I’ve attached for the call (stubs):
- redwood_procurement_form_v2.pdf — our vendor onboarding form (bank, tax, contact fields).
- MAP-draft-palmer.xlsx — suggested milestones and owners (we populated targets based on your Nov 5 PO goal).

Pre-call asks (one-sentence):
- Jordan: confirm the legal entity that will receive invoices and the signatory name (we put "Palmer Health, Inc." and left signatory blank).
- If procurement has a preferred PO numbering convention, please share.

Success criteria for this call (what we will close on):
- Agreement on PO target date (Nov 5) and owner at Palmer
- Vendor form checklist accepted or flagged for follow-up items
- MAP owners & first two milestones agreed so Redwood can issue an invoice and start onboarding once PO is received

Thanks all — looking forward.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_procurement_form_v2.pdf; MAP-draft-palmer.xlsx
